title: Diamond Elite Card: Earning 5% Cash Back on All Purchases
summary: The document explains how to earn and redeem rewards on the Diamond Elite Card: you earn 5.0% cash back on all eligible purchases, with rewards accruing when transactions post (typically within a few days). It covers statement line items (rewards earned, redemptions, return reversals) and redemption eligibility (minimum available rewards balance of at least 5), including an example formula: rewards = purchase amount × 5.0%.
